summary: Native conversation headers read live seat working state, model, context, cost and todos; header-only updates reach long polls and sockets, and register-only agents appear in history cards.

replay.detail: The header consumer reads existing live-register, observed-harness, todo and retained numeric usage projections. No additional claim replay or projection rebuild is required. Undeclared cards retain canonical graph revisions when available, with register-aware fallback revisions for register-only seats.

schema.detail: The consumer adds no database schema, migrations or generated client wire fields beyond the prerequisite live-register changes. It uses the existing conversation-blocks.v1 header object.

rules.detail: No additional checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination rules change. Working state respects observed-harness diagnostic fences and read-time freshness; todo observations respect session and incarnation staleness.

compatibility.detail: Long-poll and conversation socket responses may carry a header update with no timeline items. A present empty header object (header:{}) retracts prior live fields; an omitted header on a quiet poll leaves them unchanged. Clients that ignore empty headers can retain stale indicators until they replace or reopen the conversation; updated stui and phone consumers handle retractions.

downtime.detail: No coordinated outage or API interruption is required.

manual.detail: No configuration change is required. Use updated conversation clients to receive header-only updates and clear fields when an empty header arrives.

recovery.detail: The consumer introduces no stored conversation or header history and no additional rollback procedure. Conversation-view data remains in memory; existing live-register and numeric usage ownership is unchanged.
